title: Components as the production generator builds them: parameters, relations, views, behaviour

source.family: railway RCC box (utils/rcc-box-railway) and its parameter panel (components/bridge-workspace/panels/rcc-box-params.ts)
source.trust: production_code: what the generator draws and computes, read from its source (file:line cited per entry). A value here is the generator's DEFAULT, never a value of the drawing in hand: every size is still measured on the drawing and bound by the engine. A relation is a HYPOTHESIS to check on the drawing (calculate, check its arithmetic; set_relation or set_formulas to bind it), not a rule to apply.

connects.says: a wall stands on the bottom slab and carries the top slab
the top slab is on the walls
the bottom slab is on the base course

components.title: RCC box barrel (cells, walls, slabs, haunches)
components.what: The monolithic box: N cells of clear span × box height, outer and inner walls, top and bottom slabs, a haunch at each inside corner.

parameters.name: ClearSpan
parameters.meaning: clear width of one cell, between the inner faces of its walls

parameters.name: BoxHeight
parameters.meaning: inside height of a cell from the TOP OF THE BOTTOM SLAB to the soffit (the panel's 'Box Height H')

parameters.name: ClearHeight
parameters.meaning: clear opening above the wearing course: BoxHeight − WearingCourseThickness (the panel's 'Clear Height H')

parameters.name: OuterWallThickness
parameters.meaning: thickness of the two outer walls

parameters.name: InnerWallThickness
parameters.meaning: thickness of a wall between cells (only with more than one cell)

parameters.name: TopSlabThickness
parameters.meaning: top slab thickness
parameters.default: 0.400 m (the panel takes it from an RDSO lookup)

parameters.name: BottomSlabThickness
parameters.meaning: bottom slab thickness

parameters.name: HaunchSize
parameters.meaning: leg of the 45° haunch at each inside corner, written 'HAUNCH a X a'

parameters.name: Cells
parameters.meaning: number of cells (a count: changing it adds or removes geometry)

parameters.name: BarrelLength
parameters.meaning: length of the barrel along its axis (the longitudinal section's overall box length)

relations.source: rcc-box-params.ts:409-417 (written as + 4 × cushion for a 2H:1V slope each side; multi-bridge clipping can shorten it)

views.how: cells, walls, slabs and haunches in section; built in metres from the centre line, y as reduced level (wy = bedY − (z − bedLvl)·scale)
the barrel's length between its two ends with the top and bottom slabs, the side wall seen beyond (dashed), the earth retainer on the top slab at each end, the return walls and the embankment slopes

behaviour: BoxHeight up: the soffit and the top of the box rise from the bed level; ClearHeight rises with it; the earth cushion under the formation shrinks and the barrel shortens where the embankment slopes come down to the box (rcc-box-params.ts:419-444)
ClearSpan up: the box widens; on a symmetric box both outer faces move apart about the centre line

connects.says: the wearing course lies on the bottom slab, in the cell
the base course lies under the box
the granular filling lies under the base course

components.title: Wearing course, PCC base course, granular (sand) filling
components.what: Layers above and under the bottom slab: the wearing course on it (the road or bed surface), the PCC base course under it, the granular filling under that.

parameters.name: WearingCourseThickness
parameters.meaning: wearing course on the bottom slab

parameters.name: PccBaseThickness
parameters.meaning: PCC base course under the bottom slab

parameters.name: PccProjection
parameters.meaning: how far the PCC projects past the box's outer faces

parameters.name: GranularFillingDepth
parameters.meaning: granular / sand filling under the PCC

relations.expr: RoadLevel (bed) = top of bottom slab + WearingCourseThickness

behaviour: a layer keeps its thickness and follows what it lies on; with the bed / road level held, the bottom slab and the layers under it hang from it

connects.says: it stands on the top of the slab; its outer face is the barrel end

components.title: Earth retainer (trapezium on the top slab at a barrel end)
components.what: A small trapezoidal wall standing on the top slab at each end of the barrel, holding the ballast / earth.

parameters.name: EarthRetainerHeight
parameters.meaning: height above the top of the top slab

parameters.name: EarthRetainerTopWidth
parameters.meaning: width at the top

parameters.name: EarthRetainerBaseWidth
parameters.meaning: width on the slab

relations.expr: its outer face is the barrel end (vertical); its inner face slopes from TopWidth at the top to BaseWidth on the slab
stands on TopOfSlabLevel: TopOfRetainer = TopOfSlabLevel + EarthRetainerHeight

views.how: a trapezium at each barrel end on the top slab
the same trapezium with the top slab (TopSlabThickness) under it

behaviour: follows the top of the slab and the barrel end; keeps its own sizes when the box changes

connects.says: its outer face stays on the barrel end and its stem rises with the top of the box it retains (where one view shows both)

components.title: Return wall (RCC cantilever: stem, footing, lean concrete, coping)
components.what: A cantilever wall at each end of the barrel retaining the embankment: a stem whose outer face is vertical and whose inner face is battered, on a footing with a toe and a heel whose top slopes down to its edges, on lean concrete.

parameters.name: StemTopThickness
parameters.meaning: stem thickness at its top

parameters.name: StemBatter
parameters.meaning: how much thicker the stem is at its bottom than at its top (its inner face is battered)

parameters.name: StemBottomThickness
parameters.meaning: stem thickness where it meets the footing

parameters.name: ToeWidth
parameters.meaning: footing projection in front of the stem's outer face

parameters.name: HeelWidth
parameters.meaning: footing projection behind the stem's bottom inner face

parameters.name: FootingDepth
parameters.meaning: footing thickness at the stem

parameters.name: FootingEdgeDepth
parameters.meaning: footing thickness at its toe and heel edges (its top slopes down to them)

parameters.name: DepthBelowScour
parameters.meaning: from the scour level down to the footing bottom

parameters.name: LeanConcreteThickness
parameters.meaning: lean concrete under the footing

parameters.name: LeanConcreteProjection
parameters.meaning: how far the lean concrete projects past the footing each side

parameters.name: HeightAboveRoad
parameters.meaning: in the wall's own cross section: from the road / ground level to the top of the wall

parameters.name: Embedment
parameters.meaning: in the wall's own cross section: from the road / ground level down to the foundation level

parameters.name: ReturnWallLength
parameters.meaning: length of the wall along the embankment (plan)

relations.expr: FootingTopAtStem = FootingBottomLevel + FootingDepth; at the edges FootingBottomLevel + FootingEdgeDepth
TotalHeight = HeightAboveRoad + Embedment (the wall's own cross section)
relations.source: the C/S of return wall states both and the total

relations.expr: TopOfWallLevel = RoadLevel + HeightAboveRoad; FoundationLevel = RoadLevel - Embedment
relations.source: the C/S states TOP OF RETURN WALL, ROAD LEVEL, FND. LEVEL

views.how: at each barrel end: the stem's outer face solid and vertical from the footing up to the top of the box; its top, battered inner face and bottom DASHED (hidden); the footing dashed with toe, heel and sloped top; lean concrete hatched under it; an RL label at the footing bottom and a dimension from the scour level

views.view: C/S of return wall (its own detail, often 1:50)
views.how: the same stem, footing, lean concrete in full section, with the road / ground, top-of-wall and foundation levels, the boulder backing behind it and weep holes

components.cross_view: The SAME parameters in the longitudinal section and in the wall's own cross section: toe, heel, footing depth at the stem and at the edges, stem thickness, depth below the reference level. A size stated in both is one value (share_sizes) — check the numbers agree first.
behaviour: the stem rises with the top of the box it retains; the footing hangs from the scour / foundation level; toe and heel grow away from the stem; a thicker stem grows on its inner (earth) side, the outer face stays on the barrel end

components.title: Toe wall (small wall at the toe of the pitching / apron)
components.what: A small wall at the outer edge of the stone pitching or apron, on a footing and a levelling course.

parameters.name: ToeWallHeight
parameters.meaning: stem height above the ground / road

parameters.name: ToeWallStemThickness
parameters.meaning: stem thickness (at its top)

parameters.name: ToeWallEmbedment
parameters.meaning: stem depth below the ground / road

parameters.name: ToeWallFoundationThickness
parameters.meaning: footing thickness

parameters.name: ToeWallFoundationProjection
parameters.meaning: footing projection each side of the stem (left / right)

parameters.name: LevelingCourseThickness
parameters.meaning: levelling course under the footing

parameters.name: LevelingCourseOffset
parameters.meaning: levelling course projection past the footing (left / right)

behaviour: stands on its footing; keeps its sizes when the box changes

connects.says: it hangs under the bottom slab at the barrel end

components.title: Shear key (a key under the bottom slab at a barrel end)
components.what: A downward key of concrete under the bottom slab at a barrel end, with PCC under it.

parameters.name: ShearKeyTotalDepth
parameters.meaning: from the top of the bottom slab to the key's bottom

parameters.name: ShearKeyDepth
parameters.meaning: depth below the bottom slab: ShearKeyTotalDepth − BottomSlabThickness

parameters.name: ShearKeyToeWidth
parameters.meaning: flat bottom of the key from the barrel end

parameters.name: ShearKeySlopeRun
parameters.meaning: horizontal run of the key's sloped side up to the slab

parameters.name: PccUnderKey
parameters.meaning: PCC under the key

behaviour: follows the bottom of the box at the barrel end

components.title: Curtain wall / drop wall (cut-off walls below the scour level)
components.what: A cut-off wall going down below the scour level at the upstream / downstream end of the apron.

parameters.name: CurtainWallThickness
parameters.meaning: wall thickness

parameters.name: CurtainWallBaseHeight
parameters.meaning: height of its base block

parameters.name: CurtainWallBaseOffset
parameters.meaning: base projection each side (left / right)

parameters.name: CurtainWallDepthBelowScour
parameters.meaning: depth below the scour level

levels.name: RailLevel
levels.role: site input or formation + a fixed offset

levels.name: BedLevel / RoadLevel
levels.role: site input: the top of the wearing course in the box

levels.name: HFL
levels.role: check only (the soffit must stay above it)

levels.name: ScourLevel
levels.role: site input for the foundations of the walls at the ends
